title: Ruffled Sea-island Ruffle Sleeve Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This dress is one of those easy choices when you want to look put-together without overthinking it. The empire waist sits higher to define your shape, while the soft pleated skirt falls naturally and doesn??t cling around the midsection. The flutter sleeves give just enough coverage on the arms, making it a comfortable pick for weddings, dinners, or any event where you want to feel relaxed but still polished.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sea-island filament fabircs.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
